label: Verifier's dataset
description: A runner that knows nothing of the desk (goal/G33.3): handed a run (run {suites, commit}), it answers taken or busy, runs the suites one at a time and keeps each suite's outcome; it reports to no one. Keeps verify.db: a row per test for its first sighting and every red/green flip, stamped with the commit, the dirty tree and the UTC time of that change (goal/G8.1), beside a red its failure text, capped (goal/G21.3), and a row per run with each suite's outcome, the commit and the dirty mark. Both are read with search (goal/G21.3), which is how the desk reads a run's outcome. Records the Stacks plugin's door verdicts (door.record), and keeps the current run's output, cleared at each new run, for the Verifier tab's console (console). On its idle hour, an hour with no run handed to it, it runs the chores its manifest names. Started by the node; reached by its verbs on the loopback door (the flat apiDoor).

args.name: db
args.description: The database file. Empty: verify.db beside this server, which git ignores. Every suite hands a temp path, so a test never touches the measurements of a real run.

args.name: suiteMs
args.description: How long one suite may run before it is stopped and counted red (goal/G8.10). A hung suite prints no failure line, so without a limit it read as all green.

args.name: pull
args.description: The command run before every run, in the checkout, when the tree is CLEAN (goal/G16.13). A dirty tree is never pulled - its owner's uncommitted work is his - and is run as it stands, the run's row saying so. Empty: no pull; a suite hands a probe script so no test runs a real git pull. Spawned and awaited (goal/G21.3), so now and stop answer while it runs.

args.name: repo
args.description: The checkout it measures: its suites, its pull and its commits (goal/G21.3). Empty: the clone holding this server. A suite hands a scratch repo, so no test runs anything in a real checkout.

args.name: idleMs
args.description: The idle hour (goal/G8.4, its own clock since goal/G33.3): this long with no run handed to it, and it runs its chores. Published with every run object, so the tab counts down to this server's own hour.

args.name: idleCheckMs
args.description: How often it looks whether its idle hour is up (goal/G33.3).

args.name: chores
args.description: The idle chores (goal/G33.3): commands, one per line or separated by ';', each run in the checkout with the node's port appended, one after the other, once per quiet stretch. Each chore names the folders it updates and finds its own agent; the verifier knows neither. Empty: no chores. An agent's node names its publish here, for instance node spirit/run/process/js/deskClient/publishData.js.
